# Tier 1 — Core Medications
These medications are always useful to Medical. Often, you'll see them produced right at the beginning of the shift.
Be warned that Dexalin Plus and Saline will severely poison [textlink="Avali" link="Avali"] and [textlink="Resomi" link="Resomi"]. Amoxla or [textlink="Tirimol and Artiplates" link="MedicineT3"] are used for them instead.
Kelotane mixed with Dermaline can help to alleviate Dermaline's low overdose threshold.
Cryoxadone and Doxarubixadone are used with [textlink="Cryogenics" link="Cryogenics"], but they are easy to make and extremely versatile.
## Other Common Medications
Although not often made for distribution, these reagents below are found in Medical at the beginning of the shift. Some are prerequisites to the core medications.
